migration.objective: Require each Kaggle completion to publish and persist a lease-scoped gallery thumbnail.

routing.handoff_target: Cretona repository and live Supabase operator

authority.point_of_no_return_approver: not applicable; migration is additive and forward-fixable

include: Replace private.cretona_kaggle_complete without changing its signature.
Add a worker-only thumbnail authorization helper and INSERT/SELECT/UPDATE policies for uploads.
Require canonical video.mp4 and thumbnail.jpg objects before completion.
maintenance_or_downtime_constraints: The Kaggle notebook must be stopped while MIG-015 is applied.

data_profile_evidence: Seven existing completed projects already have backfilled thumbnails.

invariants: Only the dedicated Auth worker may upload the canonical thumbnail for its active lease.
A Kaggle project cannot become completed until both canonical Storage objects exist.
The database worker role retains no direct table grants or RLS bypass.

mixed_version_compatibility: Stop the on-demand worker; deploy MIG-015 and the matching worker bundle before claiming another job.
privacy_retention_security: No new personal data; thumbnail ownership remains the project user's UUID path.

operations.name: Verify MIG-014 and an idle worker
operations.action_or_pseudocode: Run status and verify-014; confirm no Kaggle notebook cell is processing a claimed job.
compatibility: No application behavior changes in preflight
monitoring: Gate exit status and secret-free JSON
pause_or_abort: Abort on partial MIG-015 state, active worker, or project-ref mismatch

operations.name: Apply thumbnail completion contract
operations.action_or_pseudocode: Apply the reviewed MIG-015 transaction through the guarded migration gate.
compatibility: Android and FastAPI contracts are unchanged
idempotency_and_restart: Gate refuses a full or partial re-apply
pause_or_abort: Abort on timeout, privilege mismatch, or partial state
rollback_or_forward_recovery: Forward-fix by restoring the MIG-014 function body and dropping the three new policies before new jobs complete

operations.name: Verify lease-scoped thumbnail completion
operations.action_or_pseudocode: Run verify-015 and the PostgreSQL parity suite, then process one bounded worker smoke when GPU time is available.
transaction_and_locking: Read-only verification plus one normal worker transaction
idempotency_and_restart: Verification is repeatable; Storage uploads use canonical upsert paths
pause_or_abort: Stop if upload policy rejects the canonical path or completion loses its lease
rollback_or_forward_recovery: Leave the job failed/refunded and forward-fix before retry

estimates_and_measurements: No row backfill; catalog-only transaction expected under five seconds.
rehearsal: Disposable PostgreSQL parity test applies MIG-014 then MIG-015.
correctness_and_reconciliation: Completion stores canonical video_path and thumbnail_path only after both Storage rows exist.
backup: No destructive or bulk data operation; retain Supabase managed recovery as the environment baseline.
restore_or_forward_recovery: Use a forward-fix migration; existing completed rows and objects are not deleted.
monitoring_and_alerts: Guarded status/verify output and bounded worker logs.
pause_abort_thresholds: Any lock timeout, project mismatch, partial migration, or active worker claim.
safety.observation_window: Through the first post-MIG-015 Kaggle completion and Android thumbnail load.

assumptions: The worker is on-demand and can be stopped during migration.
unknowns: Exact duration of the next free Kaggle GPU run.
limitations: The migration plan does not itself authorize or prove execution.
residual_risks: An outdated notebook bundle will fail safely after MIG-015 because it does not upload a thumbnail.
